cambridgeEvidence: Cambridge digest: this refers to what is close to the speaker and works with singular/uncountable reference; S25 narrows it to one nearby countable item. Word, translation and definition precede This is a phone/charger/cable.
scene: At an electronics repair counter, the learner personally hands a technician a nearby phone, charger and cable as one repair set; unlike S11, this is not a home-store assembly counter or naming other customers appliances.

introTargets.practiceLink: After the phone card and exact-meaning listen_choose, phrase_builder reconstructs This is a phone at the counter.
After the charger card, context_gap_grammar selects this/is/a and phrase_builder produces the whole sentence.
After the cable card, listen_build_dictation and low-support phrase_builder retrieve the exact sentence.

independentFinal.target: This is a phone. This is a charger. This is a cable.
